timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.noPlaces: Save your home, gym and office, and Pulse shows when you arrived, how long you stayed and how you got there.
timeline.trackingOff: Tracking is off. Turn it on in Places and tracking.
timeline.emptyToday: Nothing yet today. Pulse adds a stay when you arrive somewhere.
timeline.saverNote: Saver mode follows your saved places only: stops elsewhere don't show.
timeline.editHint: Times can be a few minutes late. Tap a stay to fix it.

health.hrAria: Average heart rate {{value}} beats per minute

card.title: Timeline
card.empty: Pulse adds a stay when you arrive somewhere.

edit.title: Edit stay
edit.label: Name this stop
edit.openNote: You are still here. Saving ends the stay at the time shown; the time after it is tracked as before.
edit.deleteBody: It leaves the timeline. Your saved places stay as they are.
edit.invalidTimes: Leaving must come after arriving, within two days.
edit.future: A stay cannot end in the future.

place.name: Name
place.radiusHint: 150 m suits most places. Go bigger if arrivals are missed indoors, smaller if two places are close together.
place.removeBody: Its fence stops. Past stays there show as unknown places.
place.noSpot: Set the location first: stand there and tap I'm here now, or paste coordinates.
place.permissionDenied: Pulse needs location permission to find this spot.
place.locateFailed: Could not read your location. Try again near a window.

mode.offHint: Nothing is tracked. The timeline keeps what it has.
mode.saverHint: Least battery. Only arrivals and departures at your saved places, usually a few minutes late.
mode.balancedHint: A few location checks an hour, no notification. Adds stops of 10 minutes or more elsewhere and trip distances.
mode.preciseHint: A location check every 90 seconds, with a permanent notification. Exact times and routes; uses the most battery.

settings.allowHint: Android asks on its own settings page: choose Location, then Allow all the time. Without it Pulse cannot notice while it is closed.
settings.noPlaces: No places yet. Add your home first, standing in it.
settings.privacy: Locations stay on this phone. Pulse uses no map service, and raw location points are deleted after 30 days.

tracking.serviceBody: Recording where you go. Change it in Settings › Places.
